details: The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act failed to advance in the U.S. Senate after a cloture vote of 49-50. This outcome exposes deep partisan divides and leaves the future of crypto market-structure rules uncertain, impacting institutional adoption and regulatory clarity for digital assets. Despite this setback, Congress plans to continue advancing crypto market structure legislation. Bitcoin's price movements showed resilience, holding above $80,000 despite the hawkish Fed and the CLARITY Act setback.
title: US Senate Blocks CLARITY Act, Leaving Crypto Regulation in Limbo

details: S&P Global is set to acquire OpenZeppelin, a leading provider of smart contract security solutions and audits for the Ethereum ecosystem. This acquisition of the $37 trillion smart contract library highlights growing institutional interest in securing decentralized finance (DeFi) and blockchain infrastructure, potentially enhancing trust and development within the Ethereum network.
title: S&P Global Acquires OpenZeppelin, Bolstering Ethereum Security

details: Ethereum developers have scheduled "Frame Transactions" for the upcoming Hegot upgrade. This new feature will allow users to pay gas fees without directly holding ETH, potentially simplifying the user experience and increasing accessibility for a broader audience. Separately, institutional backers are supporting a plan to cut Ethereum block times to 10 seconds.
title: Ethereum Developers Schedule 'Frame Transactions' for Hegot Upgrade

details: LayerZero (ZRO) experienced a 4% price drop as traders anticipated and reacted to a scheduled $26 million token unlock on September 20. This unlock represents 4.2% of the circulating supply and is considered routine volatility rather than a fundamental issue.
title: LayerZero (ZRO) Drops 4% Following $26M Token Unlock

details: Crypto whales have reportedly absorbed $2.2 billion worth of XRP tokens in a 96-hour spree, contributing to renewed discussions about XRP potentially reaching the $2 mark. This accumulation follows Ripple's recent voting in favor of the XRP Ledger 3.2.0 amendment, with 26% of nodes already updated.
title: XRP Whales Accumulate $2.2 Billion Tokens Amid Price Surge Talk
